title: Newegg adds Google UCP checkout integration
description:
Newegg Commerce Inc. expanded its participation in agentic commerce channels, announcing that it has integrated Google’s Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) for online checkout. The consumer electronics retailer follows other big names, including Wayfair, Walmart, Macy’s and other merchants, that have supported UCP since Google formally launched it in January. title: Edible Brands drives engagement through refresh of loyalty program, app
description:
Edible Brands relaunched its mobile app and loyalty program in late April, and the retailer has since seen meaningful results, according to chief digital officer Erica Randerson. The retailer redesigned its mobile app, which is available on iOS and Android, to “make gifting easier and more intuitive from discovery to checkout,” according to its announcement. […]
